To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) older people and their carers in rural communities use the Internet for a wide variety of purposes; 2) the Internet is a valuable source of information and support for older people; 3) older people are not using the Internet to access services as much as they might; 4) older people have a range of barriers to Internet use; 5) older people and service-providers have a range of ideas for overcoming barriers to Internet use.
